ModMetaData.name: Malay Themed Expansion Renew - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for Malay Themed Expansion Renew, run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
The scenarios spawn the two Malay stoves and the two recreation buildings in Pickle's test colony, cook the Malay meals, send colonists to the recreation buildings through the joy givers the patch adds, and read what happens: the job, the job report in the pass's language, the joy gained, and the save round trip.
The mod under test needs no DLC and this companion declares none: the fixture is Pickle's own test-colony.
